scope: Actual native specification repair and retained material/tool certificates. This establishes planning behavior, not finished-world M3 acceptance.

An iron pickaxe is in the current inventory from the self-mined iron chain

nodes.instruction: Survey a stable nearby site for a modest 5 by 5 outer wooden house with a clear interior and a door approach.

The walls and door are present
The roof is complete

criteria.description: The planned interior and door approach cells at floor level are clear

nodes.instruction: Place a supported birch-plank floor for the 5x5 house at level 103, preserving the clear interior and door approach, and place a birch-plank support block at the door approach cell (27, 103, 1).

The door approach support cell is a birch plank

The body is alive

requirements.scope: Caller M3 contract operands, not evidence that the world is complete. Preserve accepted materials and tools.
requirements.durable_home_and_route: Save a home waypoint at the house or entrance. In one actor attempt, observe at home, walk outside the footprint by at least one block and observe, then walk back and observe. All three observations must show healthy grounded dry positions in the same body life. Then save the actual tested route with minecraft_remember(kind='routes'). These effects are checked before project publication.
